title: Direct "Subscribe" button on feed names in Global Shared Stories
summary: Hey everyone, When browsing Global Shared Stories, I often find awesome new sites. Right now, if I want to subscribe to them, I have to copy the link and add it manually. It’s a bit of a hassle. Since NewsBlur already knows the original feed, could we just click the feed name (or a small “+” button next to it) to subscribe directly? It would make discovering new feeds so much easier.

Hey everyone,


When browsing **Global Shared Stories** , I often find awesome new sites. Right now, if I want to subscribe to them, I have to copy the link and add it manually. It’s a bit of a hassle.


Since NewsBlur already knows the original feed, could we just **click the feed name (or a small “+” button next to it) to subscribe directly** ?


It would make discovering new feeds so much easier.

if you click on the feed name in the upper left of a story in global shared, it will take you to the feed, with a subscribe button.
